allocation.reason: dry-run plans never contain an accelerator-allocation command

compute_contract.charged_tokens: All generated completion tokens, including masked, rejected, calibration, and failed-parser completions.
compute_contract.fail_closed: A run with unverifiable charged-token or FLOP accounting is infrastructure-invalid and is resumed or replaced with the same seed; it is not a scientific observation.
compute_contract.flops: Measured generation, policy/reference forward, and backward FLOPs; report both total and per optimizer step.
frozen_fields: number and placement of optimizer updates
compute_contract.primary_budget: fixed charged generated-token ceiling per run

regime_contract.constraints: Equal completion token counts within each group, no controller-selected zero rows, and identical active completion count across conditions.
regime_contract.dataset_split: main/train for replay and main/test[0:128] for held-out
